name: ToolMate Customer Insights
author: toolmatelabs

sections.description:
ToolMate Customer Insights gives WooCommerce stores a clearer view of what visitors actually do before they buy — or leave.

Instead of showing only page views and traffic totals, Customer Insights connects meaningful visitor activity into understandable customer journeys.

See where visitors came from, which products they viewed, how they interacted with your store, when a cart shows real purchase intent, and where potential customers dropped out.

Customer Insights also includes built-in abandoned cart and abandoned order recovery tools, allowing you to identify recoverable opportunities and send branded recovery emails from WordPress.

Understand the customer journey

Follow meaningful visitor activity from arrival to product discovery, cart activity and purchase.

Customer Insights can help you understand:

  • Where visitors came from
  • Landing pages
  • Pages visited
  • Products viewed
  • Visitor activity and engagement
  • Click activity
  • Scroll depth
  • Cart activity
  • Visit duration
  • Active browsing time
  • Traffic channels
  • Campaign information when available
  • Customer journey progression

Instead of treating every recorded session as equally important, Customer Insights separates useful visitor activity from low-signal traffic.

Find visitors that matter

The Visitors & Journeys dashboard gives you a practical overview of activity across your WooCommerce store.

See active visitors, high-intent visitors, recent visits and recorded journeys from one interface.

Customer Insights uses behavioral signals to help surface visits that appear more meaningful, while low-signal sessions can be kept out of the normal journey view.

This makes it easier to focus on people showing actual engagement with your store.

Understand cart intent

Not every cart represents the same level of purchase intent.

Customer Insights evaluates cart and visitor activity to help distinguish between different types of recorded cart behavior.

Depending on the available signals, you can see information such as:

  • Products in the cart
  • Cart value
  • Number of items
  • Pages viewed
  • Products viewed
  • Active time
  • Scroll activity
  • Traffic source
  • Visitor signals
  • Whether a recovery email can be sent

This helps turn raw WooCommerce activity into something easier to act on.

Recover abandoned carts

Customer Insights includes abandoned cart recovery directly in the Free plugin.

When an eligible cart can be contacted, recovery emails can be sent automatically after a configurable delay or manually from the customer journey interface.

Recovery features include:

  • Abandoned cart recovery emails
  • Abandoned order recovery emails
  • Automatic sending controls
  • Configurable sending delay
  • Manual recovery email sending
  • Custom email subject
  • Custom headline and message
  • Custom recovery button text
  • Sender name and email settings
  • Brand logo support
  • Multiple built-in email themes
  • Email preview
  • Optional recovery email open tracking

You can preview the customer-facing email before enabling automatic recovery.

Built-in Recovery Email Studio

Recovery Email Studio lets you customize how recovery messages look without building an email template from scratch.

Choose from included themes, configure your branding and edit the recovery message directly from WordPress.

The preview uses the same email theme and rendering system used by recovery emails, helping you see how the message will appear before it is sent.

See individual customer journeys

Open an individual journey to understand the visit in more detail.

Customer Insights can show a visit overview including:

  • First visit
  • Total visit duration
  • Active time
  • Pages viewed
  • Products viewed
  • Clicks
  • Cart actions
  • Maximum scroll depth
  • Traffic channel
  • Landing page
  • Referrer information
  • Campaign information when available

An interest score provides an additional behavioral signal to help compare visitor engagement.

Analyze your WooCommerce funnel

The Analysis Center turns recorded activity into a simple daily funnel.

See the relationship between:

  1. Visitors recorded
  2. Visitors showing meaningful signals
  3. Real cart opportunities
  4. Contactable carts
  5. WooCommerce orders

The goal is to make store activity easier to understand without assuming that every recorded session or cart represents a real customer.

Raw CSV export is also available when you want to inspect or analyze the underlying data yourself.

Designed for WooCommerce

Customer Insights is built specifically around WooCommerce customer behavior.

The plugin runs inside WordPress and presents its tools through dedicated Customer Insights admin pages.

No separate analytics dashboard is required to view your Customer Insights data.

Privacy controls

Customer Insights includes controls intended to help store owners manage how visitor and recovery information is handled.

For example, recovery email open tracking is optional and disabled by default.

Because privacy and data protection requirements vary by website, jurisdiction and configuration, installing Customer Insights does not by itself make a website compliant with GDPR or other privacy regulations.

Site owners remain responsible for configuring their website, privacy notices, consent mechanisms and data handling appropriately.

Customer Insights Pro

Customer Insights Free contains the core visitor journey, cart intelligence and recovery email functionality described above.

Customer Insights Pro is a separate plugin for stores that want additional journey insights, reporting and store intelligence.

Information about Pro is shown contextually inside Customer Insights’ own admin pages and does not replace or disable the functionality included in Free.

Learn more at ToolMateLabs.com.
sections.installation:
1. Install ToolMate Customer Insights from the WordPress Plugin Directory, or upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/toolmate-customer-insights/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Open Customer Insights in the WordPress admin area.
  5. Visit Visitors & Journeys to begin reviewing recorded customer activity.
  6. Configure recovery email branding, content and sending options in Recovery Email Studio before enabling automatic recovery emails.

Customer Insights begins building useful journey information as visitors interact with your WooCommerce store. Historical visitor journeys from before the plugin was installed cannot be reconstructed.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. ToolMate Customer Insights is designed specifically for WooCommerce stores.

Does Customer Insights track customer journeys?

Yes. Customer Insights records relevant visitor activity and combines it into customer journeys that can include page visits, product views, engagement, cart activity, traffic source and other available signals.

Can I see anonymous visitors?

Yes. Customer Insights can record meaningful anonymous visitor journeys even when the visitor has not provided an email address.

The information available depends on what is known during the visit.

Does every visitor become a customer record?

No. Customer Insights is designed to distinguish meaningful visitor activity from low-signal sessions rather than presenting every recorded request as an equally important customer journey.

Can Customer Insights recover abandoned carts?

Yes. Abandoned cart recovery is included in Customer Insights Free.

Eligible carts with the information required for recovery can receive recovery emails automatically or through manual recovery actions.

Can I customize the recovery emails?

Yes.

You can configure the recovery email subject, headline, message, button text, sender information, timing, logo and email theme.

A built-in preview lets you inspect the customer-facing design before enabling automatic sending.

Can I send recovery emails manually?

Yes. When a recorded cart is eligible for email recovery, Customer Insights can provide a manual recovery action from the customer journey interface.

Does the plugin automatically send emails after installation?

No. Automatic recovery sending can be configured from Recovery Email Studio. Review your email settings and preview your recovery email before enabling automatic sending.

Does Customer Insights track email opens?

Optional recovery email open tracking is available.

Open tracking uses a small image in recovery emails and is disabled by default.

Can I see where a visitor came from?

Customer Insights records available attribution information such as referrer, landing page, channel and campaign information.

Some information may not be available. For example, search engines such as Google generally do not provide the exact organic search query to the destination website.

What is the interest score?

The interest score is a behavioral signal designed to help compare the apparent level of engagement across recorded visitor journeys.

It should be used as an indicator rather than a guarantee that a visitor will purchase.

Does Customer Insights replace Google Analytics?

No.

Customer Insights is focused on WooCommerce customer journeys, cart intent and recovery workflows. General analytics platforms may provide broader website traffic and marketing analysis.

They can be used alongside each other.

Does Customer Insights make my store GDPR compliant?

No plugin can guarantee GDPR compliance for an entire website.

Customer Insights includes privacy-conscious controls, but store owners are responsible for determining the appropriate legal basis, disclosures, consent configuration, retention practices and other privacy requirements applicable to their website and jurisdiction.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes.

Customer Insights Pro is a separate plugin that adds additional journey insights, reporting and store intelligence.

The Free plugin remains functional on its own and includes the core functionality described on this page.
